fields.statement: QA at 538fc842 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza), read-only against the machine's real root ~/code (projects nebari and rhiza, live root daemon), RHIZA_* env cleared. rhiza daemon status --json at the root: the root daemon once (running true, top-level runs and skipped empty), a projects part for nebari (0 runs, its last_started) and for rhiza (the 2 live runs of this milestone, 13 skipped change sets with reasons such as usage reserve and umbrella), skipped_projects empty (both initialised). Human text shows Project nebari:/Project rhiza: sections. --project nebari gives only nebari's part (no projects entries); run inside ~/code/rhiza it gives rhiza's 2 runs and 13 skips at the top level; --all from inside rhiza covers both; --project nope exits 2 with not registered. Nit seen: at the root the top-level human line reads Live runs: none above the per-project sections that list 2 live runs.

QA at 538fc842 with a scratch build, read-only against the real root ~/code (nebari, rhiza). rhiza health at the root: daemon, autonomy, machine, disk and usage once untagged, then main, inbox, requests, roadmap and check once for nebari and once for rhiza, tagged (nebari: 5 behind origin/main; rhiza: 49 requests, 14 change sets, 7 check warnings), exit 0 with no bad part. Inside ~/code/rhiza and with --project nebari: one project's parts, no project tags. Defect: at the root the daemon part says 0 live runs while daemon status at the root lists 2 live runs under rhiza, and inside ~/code/rhiza health says 2 live runs. runHealth reads the machine parts through scopes[0] (nebari, first by name), so healthDaemon counts only nebari's runs; the usage part likewise reads nebari's daemon state only.

QA at 538fc842 with a scratch build. Real root ~/code, read-only: rhiza inbox at the root lists rhiza's failed run, nebari's failed run (each with project: line) and the machine-wide usage-reserve item once, untagged; inside nebari only nebari's items; --project rhiza from inside nebari only rhiza's; --all with --project exits 2. Scratch root of two hand-built projects alpha and beta (hermetic HOME, fake rex on PATH, the testscript's journal fixtures): inbox at the root tags the alpha question and beta sign-off; inbox open of alpha's question from the root focused block:q1 (rex.log shows block inspect and focus); from inside beta it is no inbox item, with --all it focuses; inbox approve --foreground --dry-run of beta's sign-off from the root reached beta's run SIGNOFFRUN01 (its fixture workflow has no steps); approve of the question is refused naming inbox open.

QA at 538fc842 with a scratch build. Scratch root of two hand-built projects (alpha with milestone ma and an accepted change set serving it, beta with a backlog change set): rhiza roadmap at the root prints ## alpha: ma and ## beta: Backlog, and --json tags every group and change set with its project; from inside beta only beta's backlog untagged, --all from inside beta both; --project alpha only alpha's milestone untagged; --project nope exits 2 not registered. Real root ~/code: only rhiza's groups (milestone-29, Backlog, areas) tagged rhiza, as nebari has no in-flight change sets (main's rhiza roadmap in nebari also shows Nothing planned yet).
